reviews.text: Great experiences at TAH. Very friendly staff and not trying to push unnecessary services.
I love this clinic so nice staff and great doctor. Positif atmosphere .
We love Turquoise Animal Hospital! They always take great care of us whether our pup is having routine check-ups or when she fights a bee. Thanks for all y’all do!

Recommend highly! I Bbought my 7 month old puppy in after rescuing him for establishing care and suture removal. They tested his stool, checked him out, removed the sutures, and I got the results back within one day, along with the medicine to treat him. It was all very simple. The staff loved him and was very kind to him. I trust them with his care and will definitely be bringing him back for regular care here.

We’ve been coming to the vets at Turquoise Animal Hospital for a year now and always have a positive experience. Everyone who works there is so kind and takes the time to explain every recommended service. What is more impressive is whenever we call them with last minute issues they always do everything they can to squeeze us in and give us peace of mind. We are so happy we found this vet when we first got our puppy and will continue to come here through all stages of his life.

The care and attention that our little dog Mango receives each time we go to Turquoise Animal Hospital is exceptional!  We gave it a go at another animal hospital in the area because they we a bit less expensive, but the experience and service didn't come close to that of this place.

I (and my boys) love this vet - the staff is so kind and helpful and truly cares so much about every pet that comes in. We’re so grateful to Dr Brecht !!

I appreciate that it’s still locally owned as well, and try to recommend them as much as possible !
Our friend recommended this place as she brings all her pets here. Our sulcata tortoise was treated well here and the staff were kind and friendly.
They take loving care of your pet.  And are NOT one of those $500 to walk thru door places!!  Have been going here for almost 2 DECADES!!!
We love Turquoise Animal Hospital! Great staff and service and excellent Dr G is so thoughtful about followup -- we feel like the folks at Turquoise really care about our dog.

This team loves animals! I've been coming here since 2007. The front desk team is helpful, knowledgeable, and friendly. The techs are so good with my high maintenance dogs. And my dogs love Dr. G and Dr. Reed. I haven't lived in PB for a few years now, but I still drive here. I've been to several other vet hospitals over the years, but I'll gladly make the drive across town to come here instead.

LOVE ❤️ TURQUOISE ANIMAL HOSPITAL!  we have taken our two Labs since they were 6weeks old.  We got Jellybean and Cocobean from Dixie’s Redemption and it has been exciting ever since.  Dr. Brecht is a great Vet,  extremely knowledgeable and helpful.  dr.Reed is also fabulous Gives us great advice.  Our 15 year old Chihuahua Ricky goes to Turquoise also and has received excellent care.  The Vet technicians and the client service specialists are also excellent and caring.  Would highly recommend TURQUOISE ANIMAL HOSPITAL.

Updating so other pet parents are aware. I still get so angry when I think that this sham of a vet put my dog under to perform a useless surgery, 2 weeks of painful recovery, and $1,000 when I was unemployed. Our next vet suggested a $30 probiotic, and $70 allergy meds which solved the problem in 4 days. Don’t support this business.

The vet told me, ‘I already spent 7 minutes — actually now 8 minutes — on the phone with you, and my time is valuable.’ He made the same remark during our visit the day before, and repeated it again on the phone. I ask questions because I believe a veterinarian has a duty of care to provide pet parents with clear medical advice.

After that, it became clear this clinic cared more about billing for shots, medications, and visits than about helping my dog.

Over two months, three visits, and over $900, my dog’s itchy paw is still unresolved. The vet kept changing his diagnosis and pushed a foxtail surgery, which found nothing. At no point did they offer any options that resembled real pathways toward healing. My dog is now spending two weeks in a cone, on heavy medication, recovering from an unnecessary procedure. All because he was licking his paw.

It feels like they created a bigger problem just to charge us more. At one visit, the vet brought my dog to me in visible pain after he made him bleed with a long sharp tool just to “show” he wouldn’t stay still.

When I asked for documentation of everything they had done, he refused, saying they don’t have time for that. I left every appointment with more questions than answers and a deep sense he simply didn’t care.

From my interactions, I felt that the dr was insensitive, and insincere.

Turquoise animal hospital has been amazing to our dog and us over the last 6 years. Ever since we got our goldendoodle as a little puppy they’ve helped us take incredible care of him and helped him stay healthy. The team there is so kind, caring, and helpful. No matter how busy they are they ensure we get the support and care we need. Cannot recommend TAH enough, their staff and doctors are the best of the best.

I’ve been a client of Turquoise Animal Hospital for many years and have had the absolute pleasure of Dr. Reed treating our rescue pups. She has always taken such incredible care of them and I trust her completely.

A few years ago my husband got really good pet insurance, but it was tied to a specific veterinary clinic, and we were honestly heartbroken because we loved Turquoise so much. Even with that change, for anything serious I still take one of our pups, Foxy, to Dr. Reed because that is how much I value her expertise and care.

Recently something scary happened and Foxy could barely walk, along with a few other concerning symptoms. Our insurance vet was closed, and Turquoise was able to get us in quickly. Dr. Reed was not available that day so I was a little nervous, but we were scheduled with Dr. G. I should not have been surprised, but the experience was amazing. He was kind, thorough, and I could truly feel how much he cared about my pup. He took the time to explain everything in detail and made sure I understood all of our options.

Hands down, this clinic is the best. From the front desk to the doctors, you can feel the compassion and integrity. If you have trust issues when it comes to veterinary care, I completely understand, and I would absolutely recommend giving Turquoise Animal Hospital a try. They genuinely care, and that peace of mind is priceless. I will continue to give them my business because the love and care they show my pups means everything to me.

This vet hospital is the best!  The docs are excellent, and the entire staff is friendly and efficient.. We have been taking our multi pet household here for many years, and we’ve always been completely satisfied.

Great staff and great care! They are largely responsible for saving my dog's life (he had parvovirus, an extremely serious condition) - and since then have been fantastic with follow up care and personalized treatments.

Danae and Michael and the rest of the front desk staff are always extremely helpful and communicative, and Dr. Reed is a real pro! Would recommend this hospital to anyone reading.

I have been with Turquoise Animal Hospital for many years and many dogs. They have always received top notch care and thorough exams. Dr. G is so patient and answers all my questions and options available. He is aware of the personality of each dog and has especially worked patiently with a very anxious dog. The front desk has been consistently helpful and organized. I am so grateful for the family feeling and excellent care.
Great with my dogs and lepoard gecko. Vets are friendly. Communication is good.
Dr. G is the best and our little pug is always treated with the most amazing care.
Absolutely one of the BEST Vets in town, Wonderful staff that always takes excellent care of all our little Yorkies (8)...

Feedback for Turquoise Veterinary Office

I’ve always had wonderful experiences every time I’ve brought Pluto in, with one exception — what happened during our most recent visits.

Three days ago, Pluto was seen by Dr. Brecht because Dr. Reed, who I consider Pluto’s primary doctor, was out that day. The visit itself went smoothly, but when Pluto had blood work done, I left feeling uncertain. There was very little clarity or direction on what I could do to help improve his kidney and liver values, other than being told he should come in for fluids the next three days.

The following day, I came back with Pluto for fluids and asked if I could speak with Dr. Reed to go over some follow-up questions about that blood work. The staff told me I couldn’t, and instead asked me to send an email with my questions. I did so, but unfortunately, I received no reply that day.

On the third day, when I brought Pluto back for fluids, I again asked if Dr. Reed could spare five minutes — even over the phone — to discuss the blood work results. I was told she was too busy, and even if she had time, she wouldn’t be the one to answer my questions since she hadn’t been the doctor who saw Pluto the day the blood work was done. I found this very frustrating, especially considering that Dr. Reed has seen Pluto every other time and is the doctor I trust most with his care.

What was most upsetting was being told that if I wanted to speak with Dr. Reed about this blood work, I would have to schedule another appointment and pay again. That doesn’t feel fair. I had already paid for the blood work and the consultation, and my follow-up questions were directly related to that same visit and those same results. I believe it’s reasonable to expect that Pluto’s primary doctor could review the results from her own office and help provide some guidance.

To be clear, my trust in Dr. Reed remains the reason I will continue bringing Pluto here. But the way the staff handled my requests left me very disappointed. I felt dismissed, unheard, and placed in a position where I was being asked to pay again just to get basic clarity on results I’d already paid for.

I hope this feedback helps improve communication and support for other pet owners in similar situations.

I have now found myself a veterinarian I feel comfortable with and that I trust with my loving pups!! I highly recommend. Read on if you want to know why😉.   Since Dr Michael left Rose Canyon animal hospital over a year ago, I have not been able to find a new veterinarian. Went to West Coast for a bit, but it didn't feel personable, and although they handled my dog with kindness and affection while he was dying, it just never felt like the small community veterinarian I feel comfortable with. I like to know my vet and for my vet to know my dog. I bought my dog to West Coast because I believe she had a fox tail in her paw and I wanted them to look at a lump on her belly. To search for the fix tail cost almost $300. My previous experience at Rose canyon was $100 or less. The lump, which our family thought was probably a fatty lump, something Dr Michael was able to diagnose, in office, on one of our other dogs,  cost a little over $100. West Coast didn't even consider that, they wanted to send a sample to the lab and it was going to cost almost $500.🙄😮 I didn't have that kind of money for minor health concerns. My other dog Cali had started at turquoise animal hospital with her previous owner so I thought I would give them a try. They were able to determine in house that it was fatty, just a little over $100. It felt personable and Dr G was very thorough and explained options for a second lump that was more questionable. I am happy to say I have found my new veterinarian ☺️. Thank you Turquoise Animal Hospital 🥰
Took our dog in for some blood work and the dr was great. Determined she may have had a muscular issue. Gave us some pain meds and she’s doing so much better. Got us in right away as well.

I have struggled to find a vet in the last decade or so since returning to San Diego. And even more so, one that would see exotics. We have had guinea pigs and cats, and we stumbled across them. We saw another exotics vet, and it wasn't a good fit, and there was a lot of dismissal (not the point of the review, though), but I bring it up because we never, ever experience that here. They have treated every pet of ours like their own, and it's clear by how they interact with us, but also how our animals respond to them.

We have unfortunately lost a couple of pets since becoming regular and established here, but they have been nothing but supportive, loving, and kind. They love our animals, they recognize us, they know who they are working with, and they are friendly.

The entire hospital is knowledgeable, and they truly have a passion for the animals they treat. It's always clean, friendly, and comfortable when we go (and we've been quite a bit in the last month).

I will continue going there for as long as we possibly can, without a doubt.

Our furbaby loves all the friendly and helpful staff and doctors at Turquoise Animal Hospital so much that he quickly forgets he’s at the vet.
We’ve also used their boarding services for one weekend due to our usual place not accepting dogs with a cone and they were able to accommodate him last minute. I got updated while we were away when he needed a new medication and his wound healed well by the time we picked him back up.

Thank you everyone at Turquoise Animal Hospital for always taking such good care of Pinto 🩵

Dr. Reed and Turquoise Animal Hospital are really the best. We've been taking our kitties and dogs to her for years.

We recently had some issues with our kitty. The mainstream animal hospital we go to, just because it's closer and easier to schedule with, was at a loss on what was going on. They recommended we take him to VCA eye clinic (which we did) then VCA eye clinic recommended we take him next door and pay over 5k for a MRI. At 11 years old, we were hoping for other ideas on how to keep him happy and comfortable.

We took him to Dr. Reed when there didn't seem to be anymore options other than an expensive MRI. Dr. Reed suggested another option and was able to keep my kitty comfortable for a few months longer, until we had to make the tough decision to let him go.

Turquoise was again there for us, and Dr. Reed personally met with us (she had shown my kitty so much love) so I wanted her there with us for his last few minutes of snuggles and love. They helped make the decision straight forward for us.

I would/and have recommended Dr. Reed at Turquoise Animal Hospital to several friends and family. She really shows animals the love and care they deserve. She is the first person I go to for a second opinion, and has (on at least two occasions now) given me other options that other clinics didn't offer. I love Dr. Reed.

They saw my puppy Hugo on short notice after he was stung by a bumble bee in the mouth. He was in distress and they took great care of him with a shot and gave us clear instructions on after visit care. Hugo’s on the up and up now and we’re grateful for this vet! Highly recommend.

We cannot thank Dr. G and the entire team enough for the exceptional care they provided to our 8 month old dog during a recent urgent situation. We were very worried and anxious, but from the moment we walked in, we felt heard, supported, and in the best hands from the whole team.

Dr. G acted quickly and took our concerns seriously - he didn’t brush anything off. He listened, ordered the appropriate tests, and followed up with genuine care. His thoughtful and thorough approach helped us feel reassured in an incredibly stressful moment, and most importantly, it led to our dog getting the treatment he needed.

It was clear that Dr. G was truly invested in helping our dog recover. That level of compassion and commitment is rare, and it meant everything to us. It also meant the world to see the techs and front desk excited to see him doing better every day.

We are forever loyal to the amazing team at Turquoise. Thank you for going above and beyond. We’re so grateful to have found a vet we trust!!
You can tell they care about their patients and you can't beat the location

Took great care of my puppy in his last few days while he was suffering from parvo. It was a heartbreaking situation and they were so helpful and friendly throughout. When it comes time to get a new dog I will definitely be taking them here
Everyone there is so nice and took great care of my baby!

Turqoise Animal Hospital killed my pet mouse Pumpkin in 2021. It is difficult to find "exotic" vet services (and mice are considered as such), so I was happy when Turqoise said they would be able to remove small tumor from my mouse's armpit. She was a young and robust mouse, less than a year old, and was not even yet showing discomfort at the tumor that was very small at the time and I was told would be simple to remove. Removal was to be preventative surgery and the doctor showed no concern at any potential surgery risks. I was given explicit written direction to NOT feed her in the hours before surgery, so I removed her from her pack (as female mice are social creatures and live in groups) and kept her isolated in the hours before surgery to ensure she did not eat, as directed. When she was returned to me after surgery, she had massive staples in her arm, was cold, and had labored breathing. I knew something was wrong immediately and should have listened to my gut, but instead I opted to believe the doctor and staff who told me all was fine. Pumpkin died, in pain, scared, and confused, mere hours after I took her home. When I called Turqoise to discuss what happened, I discovered that I was given INCORRECT pre-surgery information and that she could have been eating and stayed with her friends. I have lived with the guilt that their incorrect information and questionable surgery sutures caused my mouse to die young, hungry, scared, and alone. Given that they offered no recompense for my pet that they killed, I'm sure they cared little at the time and have forgotten since.

They have been our vet for a very long time, and with three of our babies. This last visit was an unexpectedly devastating one. They were honest and kind. They waited for my husband to come say goodbye to our beautiful boy, even though it was a bit past closing. They also made a donation to Arbor Day Foundation in honor of our Oliver, which has meant so much to us. Thank you for the meaningful work that you all do.

wanted to bring to your attention some concerns regarding my recent experiences at your clinic. While I have the utmost respect and appreciation for Dr. G, who has always provided exceptional care for my dog, I have noticed consistent …
My dog received Lazer treatment and they were so loving a kind to him. We have visited several times when we need help with our pup and they are quick, kind and caring.
The entire staff was very accumulating. Very helpful And most definitely all about the Fur babies.

Dr Melissa Reed is an amazing veterinarian.  Dr. Reed diagnosed a problem with my dog's heart simply by listening through the stethoscope.  She heard a leaky heart valve.  My dog had been to the allegedly best vet in La Jolla for 3 years …

Dr. Reed is so caring and compassionate. I brought my pug to her with some serious health conditions knowing that it might be time to let her rest. Dr. Reed talked me through the whole process and was very warm and kind with her care to …
Excellent service
